ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

My Ref. No.: Medu/3/1/2/64/17. I, hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7, of Land Acquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964 (Amendment) that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the land to be acquired: An allotment of land called Nugagala watta in total extent of 2.0186 hectares depicted as lot No. 484 in Supplement No. 19 of the Preliminary Plan F. V. P. 429, situated in the village called Hunnasgiriya in the Grama Niladhari Division Rambukpotha of Gampaha Korale-West minor division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Medadumbara in Kandy District of the Central Province and more fully described as follows.
SCHEDULE Lot Number 484 Name of the land: Nugagala Watta; Claimant: J. W. H. M. A. P. Aberatne, Rambukpoth, Medamahanuwara; Lot No.: 484; Plan No.: F. V. P. 429; Extent: 2.0186 Hectare.
All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at the Medadumbara

Divisional Secretariat on 13th July, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 06th July, 2015 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
All deeds and documents in support of the claims should be produced before me at the inquiry.
J. M. J. K. JAYASUNDARA, Divisional Secretary, Medadumbara. Divisional Secretariat, Medadumbara. 06th April, 2015. 05 - 504

III ෙකොටස - ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් අති විෙශෂ ගැසට් පතය - 2015.05.06 PART III – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 06.05.2015
PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.

Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land or servitude to acquired: A block of land named as Porake Godalla (Land of Sri Wardhanarama Purana Viharaya, Kaluwella) in total extent of 0.0025 Hectare depicted in basic plan No. 4115, situated in the Grama Niladhari Division, 96C Kaluwella in the Village of Kaluwella, in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Four Gravets Galle, District of Galle, Southern Province. The boundaries of the aforesaid block of land are as follows. Lot No. 01 — Original Claimant: Incumbent of Sri Wardhanarama Purana Viharaya, Kaluwela, Galle. North: Porakegodalla claimed by Incumbent of Sri Wardhanarama Viharaya; East: Porakegodalla claimed by Incumbent of Sri Wardhanarama Viharaya; South: Porakegodalla claimed by Incumbent of Sri Wardhana-rama Viharaya and Sri Buddhasingha Road; West: Sri Buddhasingha Road and Poakegodalla claimed by Incumbent of Sri Wardhanarama Viharaya.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands* on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat Galle on the 10th day of June, 2015 at 9.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 03rd day of June, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation and the details of the said land/servitude* the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. All deeds and documents in support of the claims should be produced before me at the inquiry. W. S. SATHYANANDA, Divisional Secretary, Galle. Divisional Secretary, Four Gravets - Galle. 29th April, 2015. 05 - 505
